claims.label: PROVED
claims.statement: For two point surgeries x,y of a bent k-bit sign, the quadratic upper-cap interaction is C_R(S)=8 sigma 2^{-k}2^{-|S|}1_{R subset S}.
claims.accepted_quantifiers: Every even k>=2, every bent Boolean g, and every distinct x,y.
claims.scope_note: R is the unique minimal generator of the algebraic support filter; this is not yet a disjoint physical pivotal-event ownership theorem.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.statement: The unweighted difference-spectrum upper-set packet has exact refund rho=4delta for r=1 and rho=8delta-2^{4-r}delta 1_{sigma=1} for r>=2; it dominates the flat-law absolute first variation 8delta2^{-r}.
claims.accepted_quantifiers: Every even k>=2, every bent Boolean g, every distinct x,y, every 1<=r<=k, and both phase signs when allowed.
claims.scope_note: A physical selector identity multiplies this packet by its selector coefficient. The coherent-parent and retained-child nonlinear residual is not controlled by this claim.

claims.label: NUMERICAL_EXACT
claims.statement: An independent exact implementation passed 963542 assertions across 2174 reconstructed point pairs, plus scalar endpoint checks for every even k<=200.
limitations: Finite corroboration is not the all-parameter proof.
